# s279 — TUI overview line shows progress and check drift

The status line shows the project's done percentage and whether the generated render is stale, so the owner sees from the TUI when `r` is needed.

**Findings:** owner request, session 2026-10-14: bring the TUI up to date with recent CLI features · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** sync drift, reference checks, and running the full `check`.

## Why

`View.status` (`src/slicer/tui.py:693`) shows only counts, sort and filters. After a note edit, the TUI asks "press r to render", but nothing shows that the render is still stale. The `r` key already computes the drift with `render.plan` and `render.compare` (`src/slicer/tui.py:404`). `slicer stats` computes completion in `_census` (`src/slicer/cli.py:3008`).

## Files

- `src/slicer/cli.py`: lift the completion part of `_census` into a function the TUI can call. `stats` output is unchanged.
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: `View.status` appends `N% done` and `render stale` when `render.compare` reports a difference. That is computed in `refresh` after each mutating action and on open, not on every keystroke.
- `docs/tui.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `tests/test_tui.py`.
